title: Round 16: longer episodes from the rule on net1 v6, with the corrected mixture
description: Round 11 tested longer horizons with a mixture that rewarded pushing, and its stage 2 (exp-net2-r11-s2-150) continued from the policies that had collapsed, so it confounded the horizon with recovery: there the 30 s cells returned to the rule's level (-0.008 and +0.008 at iteration 79) and the 120 s cells did not (-0.08 to -0.20 at tau 1 s, -0.45 at tau 5 s with dynamic competition). This is the clean test of whether longer episodes help: from net1 v6's rule (u = 0.25), with round 14's mixture (alone 0.4, compete 0.4) and learner, at equal compute per iteration (960 s of rollouts: 2 links of 4 rollouts of 120 s, against round 14's 8 links of 30 s): 120 s with tau 1 s and 5 s and diverse competition, and 120 s with tau 5 s and dynamic competition (arrivals over the first 60% of the episode, a third of flows leaving early). Round 14 (30 s, tau 1 s and 5 s, diverse) is the comparison. Seeds 1 and 2; a 4.5 h budget so that cells end within the job limit. Validation links only.
prepare: N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_setup.py "$OUT/setup" --net1 "$N" --models "$IN/models" --u 0.25 --paths net2-train-xl
run: IFS=_ read -r T TAU COMP LINKS <<< "$ARM"; S="$OUT/spec-r16-$ARM-s$SEED.json"; jq --argjson t "$T" --argjson tau "$TAU" --arg comp "$COMP" --argjson links "$LINKS" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "ppo" | .base = "fixed" | .copies_reward = "team" | .critic_flows = true | .noise_sigma = 0.2 | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .tau_s = $tau | .duration_ms = ($t * 1000) | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = $links | .lr = 0.0003 | .alone = 0.4 | .compete = 0.4 | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = $comp | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 200 | .eval_every = 20 | .time_budget_s = 16200' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r16-$ARM-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
